_doc: The film kit's demo theme: a neutral proof look (greys only) for testing the runtime. It is no channel's or client's identity. No channel fonts exist yet, so it names system-safe faces that ship with the container (DejaVu); a channel's theme lists its own WOFF2 files under fonts/ instead. Contrast (computed): text on bg 16.6, text-2 on bg 8.3, text on the caption plate over pure white 9.5, the lit word (ink on text) 16.6.
name: Film kit demo (neutral proof)
